summary: Blaze Type's template microsite for Apoc, a three-subfamily display serif (Normal, Revelations, Sans; wght 100–900): a cinematic 3D video hero of chrome letters, story paragraphs that double as testers with red pill toolbars and woodcut marginalia, pointer-driven weight panels on an engraved dark texture, faint giant marquees between sections, a pairing tester and in-use galleries.

instances.look: Full-width video of chrome, mirror-polished 3D serif letters ('Apoc Revelations', 'New Styles Available', 'Gehenna') flying through a dark voxel city lit by red glows, inset 40px on white, with a white mute icon bottom-right and the slim 'Buy Apoc · APOC · Download Trial' bar on top
instances.ux: Autoplay muted loop; the mute button toggles sound; clicking the video smooth-scrolls one viewport down; Buy and Trial links in the fixed bar
instances.learn: Render the family's words as reflective 3D objects in a film-like scene: a display serif gets drama a flat specimen can't give

reconstruction.layout: Video box x=40, y=40, 1360×870 (~95vh), object-fit cover; mute icon 36px at bottom-right with 16px inset; fixed white bar 54px above
reconstruction.typography: No live display type; letters are rendered in the video (Apoc Revelations, italics included); bar labels ~16px Apoc, centre logo 'APOC' ~36px caps
reconstruction.behaviour: Looping 3D render video; .intro-btn-mute swaps icon-sound-off / icon-sound-on and toggles muted; onclick → window.scrollTo(innerHeight − header height); white page for ~2s while loading
reconstruction.content: Words from the theme: 'Apoc Revelations', 'New Styles Available', 'Gehenna', 'Great…'
reconstruction.assets: 3D-rendered video loop (videos/apoc_home.mp4) of chrome letters in a dark cityscape with red lights
reconstruction.html: section#intro > div.intro-poster > video.intro-poster-bg[autoplay muted loop] + div.intro-btn-mute > svg.icon-sound-off + svg.icon-sound-on

instances.look: Under the video, a four-line paragraph in black Apoc Revelations at ~39px across the full width, with 'Apoc(alypse)' and 'the most popular typeface of contemporary independant design' picked out in red

instances.learn: Colour a few phrases of the intro red: the paragraph reads as a specimen and the accent colour becomes the site's highlight system

(Revelations) and 'It will do marvels if you want to balance your layout's optical gray…' (Sans)
